defs.def: a completely round flat shape 圆；圆形
the line that forms the edge of a circle 圆周；圆圈
a thing or a group of people or things shaped like a circle 圆形物；环状物；圈；环

ex.s: A spotlight lights up only one section of a stage; similarly,"spotsound" creates a circle of sound in on targeted area.
ex.t: 聚光灯只照亮舞台上的一个区域；类似地，“spotsound”在目标区域制造一个声音圈。

ex.s: The polar bear is found in the Arctic Circle and some big land masses as far south as Newfoundland.
ex.t: 北极熊生活在北极圈内和一些向南远至纽芬兰的大型陆地上。

defs.def: an upper floor of a theatre or cinema/movie theater where the seats are arranged in curved rows （剧院或电影院的）弧形楼座
a group of people who are connected because they have the same interests, jobs, etc. （相同兴趣、职业等的人形成的）圈子，阶层，界

ex.s: To get a reward from the artistic circle.
ex.t: 为了从艺术界获得奖励。

ex.s: Robutt would knock him out of trouble when he was too near a rock, jump on him to show how much he loved him, or go round in circles making noises as if he was scared when Jimmy hid behind a rock.
ex.t: 当罗伯特太靠近一块岩石时，他会把他从麻烦中解救出来，跳到他身上以显示他有多爱他，或者绕圈子制造噪音，好像当吉米躲在岩石后面时他很害怕。

defs.def: to move in a circle, especially in the air （尤指在空中）盘旋，环行，转圈

ex.s: They take their driverless car to an appointment and set the empty vehicle to circle the building to avoid paying for parking.
ex.t: 他们开自动驾驶汽车赴约，让空车绕楼转圈以逃避停车费。

defs.def: to draw a circle around sth 围绕 … 画圈；圈出；圈起

ex.s: Write a letter of advice 1 Circle the correct word(s) in each sentence.
ex.t: 写一封建议信1在每句话中圈出正确的单词。

ex.s: Cao Jing Lily Max 2 Listen again and circle the expressions that you hear in the conversation.
ex.t: 曹经莉莉Max2再听一遍，圈出你在谈话中听到的表情。

ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。
